description: This file defines types and functions related to tracing in OpenTelemetry, including TraceID, SpanID, TraceFlags, and SpanContext, with methods for validation, JSON marshaling, and hex conversions.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the errorConst.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if TraceID or SpanID is valid (not all zeros).

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Custom JSON marshaling for TraceID, SpanID, and TraceFlags.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns hex string representation of TraceID or SpanID.

methods.name: hexBytes
methods.description: Returns byte array of hex representation for TraceID or SpanID.

methods.name: TraceIDFromHex
methods.description: Converts hex string to TraceID, validating length and characters.

methods.name: SpanIDFromHex
methods.description: Converts hex string to SpanID, validating length and characters.

methods.name: IsSampled
methods.description: Checks if the sampled bit is set in TraceFlags.

methods.name: WithSampled
methods.description: Sets or clears the sampled bit in TraceFlags.

methods.name: hexBytes
methods.description: Returns hex byte array for TraceFlags.

methods.name: NewSpanContext
methods.description: Constructs a new SpanContext from a config.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if SpanContext has valid TraceID and SpanID.

methods.name: IsRemote
methods.description: Checks if SpanContext is remote.

methods.name: WithRemote
methods.description: Returns a copy of SpanContext with remote flag set.

methods.name: TraceID
methods.description: Returns the TraceID from SpanContext.

methods.name: HasTraceID
methods.description: Checks if TraceID is valid.

methods.name: WithTraceID
methods.description: Returns a new SpanContext with TraceID replaced.

methods.name: SpanID
methods.description: Returns the SpanID from SpanContext.

methods.name: HasSpanID
methods.description: Checks if SpanID is valid.

methods.name: WithSpanID
methods.description: Returns a new SpanContext with SpanID replaced.

methods.name: TraceFlags
methods.description: Returns the TraceFlags from SpanContext.

methods.name: IsSampled
methods.description: Checks if the sampling bit is set in TraceFlags.

methods.name: WithTraceFlags
methods.description: Returns a new SpanContext with TraceFlags replaced.

methods.name: TraceState
methods.description: Returns the TraceState from SpanContext.

methods.name: WithTraceState
methods.description: Returns a new SpanContext with TraceState replaced.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks equality of two SpanContext instances.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Custom JSON marshaling for SpanContext.
